title: Digital receivable unit processed successfully
description: Emitted as the contract_digital_receivable_unit_processed_success event type when a contract operation is applied to a digital receivable unit (Brazil-only): a contract creation or inclusion applies the contract to the unit, a contract exclusion or termination unlinks it, and a contract renegotiation moves the unit to the destination contract. One event is emitted per affected unit. Consumers can use it to track which contract is applied to each unit and the resulting unit status.

digital_receivable_unit_id.title: Digital receivable unit ID
digital_receivable_unit_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v7) of the digital receivable unit, generated by Pismo. A unit groups the digital receivables that share the same lender, debtor and maturity date.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: Pismo-generated identifier of the contract linked to the unit after the operation; on renegotiation it is the destination contract. Absent on contract exclusion and termination events, because the contract is unlinked from the unit before the event is built.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Operation identifier of the contract linked to the unit, as informed when the contract was created. Absent under the same conditions as contract_id.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: Document number (CPF or CNPJ) of the lender of the digital receivables grouped in the unit; together with debtor_document_number and maturity_date it identifies the unit.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: Document number (CPF or CNPJ) of the debtor of the digital receivables grouped in the unit; together with lender_document_number and maturity_date it identifies the unit.

creditor_document_number.title: Creditor document number
creditor_document_number.description: Document number of the contract creditor, taken from the contract linked to the unit. Absent when no contract is linked to the unit after the operation.

status.title: Unit status
status.description: Situation of the digital receivable unit after the operation, serialized from DigitalReceivableUnitSituationType; applying a contract sets BLOCKED and unlinking a contract sets ACTIVE. ACTIVE: The unit has no contract applied and can receive one. BLOCKED: A contract is applied to the unit. COMPLETED: The unit lifecycle is finished. INACTIVE: The unit is no longer in use.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date shared by the digital receivables grouped in the unit, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

digital_receivables_affected.title: Affected digital receivables
digital_receivables_affected.description: Integer count related to the operation. On contract application it is the number of digital receivables of the unit linked to the contract; on termination and renegotiation it is the number of units processed in the same batch (up to 100); absent on single contract exclusion.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Domain operation that triggered the event, taken from the originating contract command. CREATE_CONTRACT: Contract creation. UPDATE_CONTRACT: Contract update, including inclusion, change, exclusion and renegotiation. DELETE_CONTRACT: Contract termination. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act creation. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act update. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act termination.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specialization of feature_type, serialized from the OperationType enum. Contract flows use CREATE_CONTRACT on creation, UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE or UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL on update (exclusion and renegotiation use UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL), and CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD or CLOSING_RNGC on termination according to the termination reason.
